prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, fully transparent PNG outside the frame. Draw a wonky skewed rounded quadrilateral border — NOT a straight rectangle: left edge nearly vertical, top edge slopes gently down left-to-right, right edge tapers inward toward the top, bottom edge slopes up left-to-right, all four corners heavily rounded like a soft bubble sticker. Border stroke solid teal #4DB6AC, medium weight about 5px, empty transparent interior except the character. Lineless Corporate Memphis style — no black outlines on the figure, flat color fills, minimal cel-shade on clothing only. Young man, SHS-college age, medium warm beige skin, short curly dark hair, minimal dot eyes and small smile. White shirt under teal #4DB6AC utility vest with small lavender #9575CD pocket stripe, dark charcoal trousers, dark sneakers. Three-quarter pose standing, holding a wrench with lavender grip, compact toolbox at side, small gear near shoulder. Figure placed off-center toward the right inside the frame. Friendly capable builder energy. NO text, NO letters, NO background fill, NO floor, NO white canvas — transparent alpha everywhere outside the teal border stroke.
